# Retrospective Memories

| Date | Cycle/Feature | Error/Friction | Root Cause | Prevention Rule |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 2026-08-13 | Facility create | Pre-feature workflow adjustments (scaffolding alignment, agent tuning, doc relocation) consumed delivery turns before implementation. | Governance/process edits were executed inside the same feature cycle. | Run governance/scaffolding/doc-structure changes in a separate prep cycle; start feature cycle only after a stable conventions checkpoint. |
| 2026-08-13 | Facility create | Facility requirements were sent repeatedly before planning kickoff. | No enforced single intake template and no planner acknowledgment gate. | Use one normalized feature brief template and require planner ACK before delegation/execution. |
| 2026-08-13 | Facility create | Optimizer first-pass lookup targeted Doc/* while active convention is .github/doc/*. | Path convention drift between legacy agent text and active .github/doc/*. | Define a single DOC_ROOT alias (.github/doc) and reference that alias across planner/orchestrator/optimizer instructions. |
| 2026-09-21 | Facility CRUD completion | User required a confirmation gate after each of 7 increments, multiplying orchestration/hand-off turns vs. autonomous pipeline. | Higher control/lower blast-radius preference for a CRUD-completion feature touching repository, commands, queries, controller, and client. | Reserve per-increment confirmation gates for high-risk or architecturally novel cycles; for CRUD-completion mirroring an existing pattern (e.g. Player), default to batched confirmation (every 2-3 increments) unless user requests finer granularity. |
| 2026-09-21 | Facility CRUD completion | Acceptance tests returned HTTP 500 because `Gaffer.Api.Tests/TestFixture.cs` manually duplicates DI registrations instead of reusing `Startups/*Startup.cs`, so 3 new handlers were missing from the test fixture. | Test DI wiring is hand-maintained and drifts from production Startup composition. | When adding new commands/queries/handlers, update `TestFixture.cs` DI registrations in the same increment as the handler, or refactor `TestFixture.cs` to reuse `Startups/*Startup.cs` composition to eliminate the drift risk. |
| 2026-09-21 | Facility CRUD completion | nswag client regen failed until `nswag.json` `targetFramework` was manually fixed from net9.0 to net10.0. | nswag config isn't updated automatically when the solution's target framework is upgraded. | After any .NET SDK/target-framework upgrade, check and update `nswag.json` targetFramework before running client regen; add this as a post-upgrade checklist item. |
| 2026-09-21 | Facility CRUD completion | No AI Insights/Token Watch data was available in any subagent invocation across the entire cycle; all 12 token lines are n/a. | Token Watch/AI Insights extension may not be installed/enabled, or subagent contexts don't inherit access to it. | Investigate whether Token Watch/AI Insights is available to subagent contexts; until confirmed, expect n/a token data for subagent-heavy cycles and do not treat it as a one-off measurement gap. |
